block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Specification of simulation snapshot capture triggers, retention policies, and FNV-1a state hashing rules.
what_it_enables: Event-driven auto-checkpoint triggers across tactical turns and narrative milestones
Deterministic FNV-1a 32-bit state hashing to catch simulation drift immediately
Protected snapshot slots for golden checkpoints and emergency post-mortem rewind
invariants: Total snapshots in memory must never exceed DEBUG_MAX_SNAPSHOTS (64)
Zero dynamic heap memory allocations during snapshot capture or rewind
Universal 5-Block Lifecycle Protocol enforced across all definitions
